content: Google Sheets GViz tqx=out:json returns JSONP wrapped as /*O_o*/google.visualization.Query.setResponse({...}); browsers must strip the wrapper (indexOf('{') to lastIndexOf('}')) before JSON.parse. X-DataSource-Auth header returns pure JSON but cannot be set from browser fetch without CORS preflight failure, so the strip approach is correct. Sheet must be publicly shared (anyone with link). Date cells arrive as Date(y,m,d) strings. Existing production code already implements the correct strip+parse; extract to a shared lib module.
